place: Rondonia, Brazil, near emem's Amazon-frontier demo point (-9.730, -63.030)

grid.note: each grid node is one sampled cell64 (about 10 m); nodes are about 740 m apart; values are point samples, not area means

eudr_rule: EUDR cut-off 2020-12-31. eudr_flag_forest_2020_loss_after_2020 = JRC GFC2020 forest_2020 == 1 AND Hansen loss_year > 2020. loss_after_2020_on_gfc2020_non_forest = Hansen loss_year > 2020 on a cell JRC GFC2020 maps as non-forest (maps disagree; not an EUDR flag under this rule).
